welcome_page.title: Welcome to Your Experience With Cycling
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on your experience as a cyclist or e-bike rider. Your answers help us understand the conditions and barriers people face when cycling in the city, and identify opportunities to make cycling safer, more accessible, and more practical for everyday travel. Participation is voluntary and anonymous.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

sections.title: Cycling Habits
sections.description: Questions about how and when you cycle as part of your daily travel.

questions.text: Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a mode of travel at least once a week?

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: Which type of bicycle do you most often use?

options.text: Standard pedal bicycle (private)
Electric bicycle / e-bike (private)
Shared / hire bicycle (docked or dockless)
Shared / hire e-bike
Cargo bike or adapted bike

questions.text: How confident are you cycling in urban traffic in your city?

options.text: Not confident at all — I avoid cycling in traffic
Not very confident — I cycle only when I have no alternative
Neither confident nor unconfident
Somewhat confident — I manage most situations comfortably
Very confident — I cycle in all conditions without difficulty
I have never cycled in urban traffic

questions.text: How adequate is the cycling infrastructure (cycle lanes, paths, and signage) on your typical route?

options.text: Very inadequate — little or no cycling infrastructure exists
Inadequate — some provision exists but it is fragmented or poorly designed
Partially adequate — infrastructure covers part of my route
Mostly adequate — infrastructure is reasonably good along most of my route
Very adequate — cycling infrastructure is excellent throughout my route

questions.text: Which of the following physical barriers do you face on your cycling route? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Uneven or poorly maintained road surfaces (potholes, patches, cobblestones)
Steep or sudden changes in gradient
Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle lanes
Pedestrians or e-scooters using cycle lanes
Road furniture blocking cycle paths (bins, signage, advertising boards)
Lack of cycle-friendly crossings or traffic signals
Poorly designed junctions or roundabouts
I don't face any physical barrier
Other

questions.text: If you encounter poor road or path surfaces (potholes, cobblestones, or uneven ground), how does it affect your cycling?

options.text: It does not affect my cycling at all
I notice it but continue without changing my behaviour
I slow down or adjust my line but stay on the same route
I actively avoid roads with poor surfaces, even if the alternative is longer
Poor surfaces significantly limit where and how often I can cycle

questions.text: To what extent does the steepness of your route affect your cycling?

options.text: Not at all
Slightly — I notice hills but they do not significantly affect my journey
Moderately — hills slow me down or increase my effort noticeably
Significantly — I avoid steep routes when possible
Extremely — hills are a major barrier that limits where I can cycle

questions.text: How does the quality of signs and wayfinding on your cycling route affect your journey?

options.text: Not at all — I can navigate easily regardless of signage quality
Slightly — signs are occasionally helpful
Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm my route
Significantly — unclear or missing signs sometimes disrupt my journey
Very significantly — poor signage makes navigation difficult without GPS or phone apps

questions.text: How do traffic levels and vehicle speeds on your cycling route typically affect your journey?

options.text: Not at all — traffic does not affect my cycling experience
Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rarely affects my comfort or route
Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces my comfort or enjoyment while cycling
Significantly — traffic often makes me feel stressed or unsafe
Very significantly — I change my route or travel time specifically to avoid heavy or fast traffic

questions.text: Which categories of road users most negatively affect your sense of safety while cycling?

options.text: Car drivers
Motorcycle or scooter riders
Bus drivers
Delivery vehicles (vans, cargo bikes, scooters)
Taxi or ride-hailing drivers
Other cyclists
E-scooter riders
Pedestrians
None — no category negatively affects my feeling of safety
Other

questions.text: How confident are you in your ability to anticipate and react to dangerous situations while cycling (e.g., car doors opening suddenly, vehicles cutting across, or blind junctions)?

options.text: Not confident at all — I feel unprepared for these situations
Slightly confident — I am aware of the risks but often feel caught off guard
Moderately confident — I manage most situations but some still worry me
Quite confident — I anticipate most hazards and respond well
Very confident — I feel well prepared for all typical cycling hazards

questions.text: How does street lighting affect your decision to cycle after dark?

options.text: Lighting levels have no influence on my decision to cycle after dark
I notice poor lighting but it does not change when or where I cycle
I cycle at reduced speed or stay on higher-lit roads in poorly lit areas
I take significantly longer routes to stay in well-lit areas
I do not cycle after dark because of poor lighting

questions.text: How would you describe the availability of bicycle parking at your most frequent destination?

options.text: Very inadequate — there is nowhere secure to park my bicycle
Inadequate — parking exists but is too limited or too far from my destination
Partially adequate — parking is available but not always convenient or secure
Mostly adequate — I can usually find a suitable place to park
Very adequate — secure and convenient parking is always available

questions.text: Has the lack of secure bicycle parking ever caused you to change your travel plans or leave your bike at home?

options.text: Never
Rarely
Sometimes
Often
Always — lack of parking is a constant barrier to cycling

questions.text: What improvements would most encourage you to cycle more often or for longer distances?

options.text: More dedicated and physically separated cycle lanes
Better road surface quality on cycling routes
More secure bicycle parking at destinations
More secure bicycle storage near home
Reduced vehicle speeds in residential areas
Better cycle-friendly junctions and crossings
More trees and shade along cycling routes
Better street lighting on cycling routes
Access to cycle training or skills courses
Financial incentives (e.g., employer cycling allowance, subsidised bike purchase)
Nothing — I am satisfied with current conditions
Other

it.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Cy: SmartUrbanity - La tua esperienza con la bicicletta
it.#8. Your Experience With Cycling: 8. La tua esperienza con la bicicletta
it.#Welcome to Your Experience With Cycling: Benvenuto/a nel questionario sulla tua esperienza con la bicicletta
it.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Questo questionario SmartUrbanity si concentra sulla tua esperienza come ciclista o utilizzatore/utilizzatrice di e-bike. Le tue risposte ci aiutano a comprendere le condizioni e gli ostacoli che le persone incontrano quando si spostano in bicicletta in città e a individuare opportunità per rendere la mobilità ciclistica più sicura, accessibile e pratica negli spostamenti quotidiani. La partecipazione è volontaria e anonima.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>Questions about how and when you cyc: Domande su come e quando utilizzi la bicicletta nei tuoi spostamenti quotidiani.
it.#Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a m: Utilizzi la bicicletta, comprese le e-bike, come mezzo di trasporto almeno una volta alla settimana?
it.#Which type of bicycle do you most often: Quale tipo di bicicletta utilizzi più frequentemente?
it.#Shared / hire bicycle (docked or dockle: Bicicletta condivisa / a noleggio (con o senza stazione)
it.#How confident are you cycling in urban: Quanto ti senti sicuro/a nel pedalare nel traffico urbano della tua città?
it.#Not confident at all — I avoid cycling: Per niente sicuro/a — evito di pedalare nel traffico
it.#Not very confident — I cycle only when: Poco sicuro/a — uso la bicicletta solo quando non ho alternative
it.#Somewhat confident — I manage most situ: Abbastanza sicuro/a — gestisco la maggior parte delle situazioni senza particolari difficoltà
it.#Very confident — I cycle in all conditi: Molto sicuro/a — pedalo in tutte le condizioni senza difficoltà
it.#I have never cycled in urban traffic: Non ho mai pedalato nel traffico urbano
it.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: Quanto è adeguata l’infrastruttura ciclabile, comprese piste, percorsi e segnaletica, lungo il tuo tragitto abituale?
it.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Del tutto inadeguata — l’infrastruttura ciclabile è scarsa o assente
it.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: Inadeguata — esistono alcune infrastrutture, ma sono frammentate o mal progettate
it.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Parzialmente adeguata — l’infrastruttura copre solo una parte del mio percorso
it.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: Per lo più adeguata — l’infrastruttura è abbastanza buona lungo gran parte del mio percorso
it.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Molto adeguata — l’infrastruttura ciclabile è eccellente lungo tutto il mio percorso
it.#Which of the following physical barrier: Quali dei seguenti ostacoli fisici incontri lungo il tuo percorso in bicicletta? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#Uneven or poorly maintained road surfac: Pavimentazione irregolare o in cattive condizioni (buche, rattoppi, sampietrini)
it.#Steep or sudden changes in gradient: Pendenze elevate o variazioni improvvise della pendenza
it.#Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle: Auto o altri veicoli parcheggiati che bloccano le piste ciclabili
it.#Pedestrians or e-scooters using cycle l: Pedoni o monopattini elettrici sulle piste ciclabili
it.#Road furniture blocking cycle paths (bi: Arredo urbano che ostacola i percorsi ciclabili (cassonetti, segnaletica, cartelloni pubblicitari)
it.#Lack of cycle-friendly crossings or tra: Mancanza di attraversamenti o semafori adatti ai ciclisti
it.#If you encounter poor road or path surf: Quando incontri strade o percorsi in cattive condizioni, come buche, sampietrini o superfici irregolari, in che modo ciò influisce sui tuoi spostamenti in bicicletta?
it.#It does not affect my cycling at all: Non influisce affatto sui miei spostamenti in bicicletta
it.#I notice it but continue without changi: Me ne accorgo, ma continuo senza cambiare comportamento
it.#I slow down or adjust my line but stay: Rallento o modifico la traiettoria, ma rimango sullo stesso percorso
it.#I actively avoid roads with poor surfac: Evito attivamente le strade con superfici in cattive condizioni, anche se il percorso alternativo è più lungo
it.#Poor surfaces significantly limit where: Le superfici in cattive condizioni limitano significativamente dove e quanto spesso posso usare la bicicletta
it.#To what extent does the steepness of yo: In che misura la pendenza del percorso influisce sui tuoi spostamenti in bicicletta?
it.#Slightly — I notice hills but they do n: Poco — noto le salite, ma non influenzano significativamente il mio viaggio
it.#Moderately — hills slow me down or incr: Moderatamente — le salite mi rallentano o aumentano sensibilmente lo sforzo
it.#Significantly — I avoid steep routes wh: Molto — evito i percorsi ripidi quando possibile
it.#Extremely — hills are a major barrier t: Moltissimo — le salite rappresentano un ostacolo importante che limita i luoghi in cui posso andare in bicicletta
it.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: In che modo la qualità della segnaletica e delle indicazioni di orientamento lungo il percorso ciclabile influisce sul tuo viaggio?
it.#Not at all — I can navigate easily rega: Per niente — riesco a orientarmi facilmente indipendentemente dalla qualità della segnaletica
it.#Slightly — signs are occasionally helpf: Poco — la segnaletica è utile solo occasionalmente
it.#Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm: Moderatamente — mi affido alla segnaletica per confermare il percorso
it.#Significantly — unclear or missing sign: Molto — indicazioni poco chiare o mancanti a volte rendono più difficile il mio viaggio
it.#Very significantly — poor signage makes: Moltissimo — una segnaletica insufficiente rende difficile orientarsi senza GPS o applicazioni sul telefono
it.#How do traffic levels and vehicle speed: In che modo il livello di traffico e la velocità dei veicoli lungo il tuo percorso ciclabile influenzano normalmente il tuo viaggio?
it.#Not at all — traffic does not affect my: Per niente — il traffico non influisce sulla mia esperienza in bicicletta
it.#Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rar: Poco — noto il traffico, ma raramente influisce sul mio comfort o sul percorso
it.#Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces: Moderatamente — il traffico a volte riduce il mio comfort o il piacere di pedalare
it.#Significantly — traffic often makes me: Molto — il traffico mi fa spesso sentire stressato/a o in pericolo
it.#Very significantly — I change my route: Moltissimo — cambio percorso o orario di viaggio appositamente per evitare traffico intenso o veloce
it.#Which categories of road users most neg: Quali categorie di utenti della strada influenzano più negativamente la tua percezione di sicurezza mentre pedali?
it.#Delivery vehicles (vans, cargo bikes, s: Veicoli per le consegne (furgoni, cargo bike, scooter)
it.#Taxi or ride-hailing drivers: Conducenti di taxi o servizi di ride-hailing
it.#None — no category negatively affects m: Nessuna — nessuna categoria influisce negativamente sulla mia percezione di sicurezza
it.#How confident are you in your ability t: Quanto ti senti sicuro/a della tua capacità di prevedere e affrontare situazioni pericolose mentre pedali, ad esempio porte di auto che si aprono improvvisamente, veicoli che tagliano la strada o incroci con scarsa visibilità?
it.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Per niente sicuro/a — mi sento impreparato/a ad affrontare queste situazioni
it.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Poco sicuro/a — sono consapevole dei rischi, ma spesso vengo colto/a di sorpresa
it.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Moderatamente sicuro/a — gestisco la maggior parte delle situazioni, ma alcune mi preoccupano ancora
it.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Abbastanza sicuro/a — prevedo la maggior parte dei pericoli e reagisco bene
it.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Molto sicuro/a — mi sento ben preparato/a ad affrontare i pericoli tipici della mobilità ciclistica
it.#How does street lighting affect your de: In che modo l’illuminazione stradale influisce sulla tua decisione di usare la bicicletta dopo il tramonto?
it.#Lighting levels have no influence on my: Il livello di illuminazione non influisce sulla mia decisione di andare in bicicletta dopo il tramonto
it.#I notice poor lighting but it does not: Noto la scarsa illuminazione, ma non cambia quando o dove uso la bicicletta
it.#I cycle at reduced speed or stay on hig: Nelle zone poco illuminate pedalo più lentamente o scelgo strade meglio illuminate
it.#I take significantly longer routes to s: Scelgo percorsi significativamente più lunghi per rimanere in zone ben illuminate
it.#I do not cycle after dark because of po: Non uso la bicicletta dopo il tramonto a causa della scarsa illuminazione
it.#How would you describe the availability: Come descriveresti la disponibilità di parcheggi per biciclette presso la tua destinazione più frequente?
it.#Very inadequate — there is nowhere secu: Del tutto inadeguata — non esiste un luogo sicuro in cui parcheggiare la bicicletta
it.#Inadequate — parking exists but is too: Inadeguata — i parcheggi esistono, ma sono troppo pochi o troppo lontani dalla destinazione
it.#Partially adequate — parking is availab: Parzialmente adeguata — il parcheggio è disponibile, ma non sempre è comodo o sicuro
it.#Mostly adequate — I can usually find a: Per lo più adeguata — di solito riesco a trovare un posto adatto
it.#Very adequate — secure and convenient p: Molto adeguata — è sempre disponibile un parcheggio sicuro e comodo
it.#Has the lack of secure bicycle parking: La mancanza di un parcheggio sicuro per biciclette ti ha mai portato a cambiare i tuoi programmi di viaggio o a lasciare la bicicletta a casa?
it.#Always — lack of parking is a constant: Sempre — la mancanza di parcheggi è un ostacolo costante all’uso della bicicletta
it.#What improvements would most encourage: Quali miglioramenti ti incoraggerebbero maggiormente a usare la bicicletta più spesso o per distanze più lunghe?
it.#More dedicated and physically separated: Più piste ciclabili dedicate e fisicamente separate dal traffico
it.#Better road surface quality on cycling: Migliore qualità della pavimentazione lungo i percorsi ciclabili
it.#More secure bicycle parking at destinat: Più parcheggi sicuri per biciclette presso le destinazioni
it.#More secure bicycle storage near home: Più spazi sicuri per custodire la bicicletta vicino a casa
it.#Reduced vehicle speeds in residential a: Riduzione della velocità dei veicoli nelle aree residenziali
it.#Better cycle-friendly junctions and cro: Incroci e attraversamenti più adatti ai ciclisti
it.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: Più alberi e zone d’ombra lungo i percorsi ciclabili
it.#Better street lighting on cycling route: Migliore illuminazione stradale lungo i percorsi ciclabili
it.#Access to cycle training or skills cour: Accesso a corsi di formazione o abilità ciclistiche
it.#Financial incentives (e.g., employer cy: Incentivi economici, ad esempio indennità aziendali per chi usa la bicicletta o contributi per l’acquisto
it.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: Nessun miglioramento — sono soddisfatto/a delle condizioni attuali

fr.#Welcome to Your Experience With Cycling: Bienvenue dans le questionnaire sur votre expérience à vélo
fr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Ce questionnaire SmartUrbanity porte sur votre expérience à vélo ou à vélo électrique. Vos réponses nous aident à comprendre les conditions et les obstacles rencontrés en ville et à trouver des moyens de rendre les déplacements à vélo plus sûrs, plus accessibles et plus pratiques au quotidien. La participation est volontaire et anonyme.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#<p>Questions about how and when you cyc: Questions sur la façon dont vous utilisez le vélo dans vos déplacements quotidiens.
fr.#Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a m: Utilisez-vous un vélo, y compris un vélo électrique, comme moyen de transport au moins une fois par semaine ?
fr.#Which type of bicycle do you most often: Quel type de vélo utilisez-vous le plus souvent ?
fr.#Shared / hire bicycle (docked or dockle: Vélo partagé / de location (avec ou sans station)
fr.#How confident are you cycling in urban: À quel point vous sentez-vous en confiance lorsque vous circulez à vélo dans le trafic urbain de votre ville ?
fr.#Not confident at all — I avoid cycling: Pas du tout en confiance — j’évite de circuler à vélo dans le trafic
fr.#Not very confident — I cycle only when: Peu en confiance — je circule à vélo dans le trafic seulement si je n’ai pas d’autre solution
fr.#Neither confident nor unconfident: Ni en confiance ni mal à l’aise
fr.#Somewhat confident — I manage most situ: Plutôt en confiance — je gère la plupart des situations sans difficulté
fr.#Very confident — I cycle in all conditi: Très en confiance — je circule à vélo dans toutes les situations sans difficulté
fr.#I have never cycled in urban traffic: Je n’ai jamais circulé à vélo dans le trafic urbain
fr.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: Les infrastructures cyclables de votre trajet habituel, comme les pistes, les voies et la signalisation, sont-elles adaptées ?
fr.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Très insuffisantes — il y a peu ou pas d’infrastructures cyclables
fr.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: Insuffisantes — certaines infrastructures existent, mais elles sont discontinues ou mal conçues
fr.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Partiellement adaptées — les infrastructures couvrent une partie de mon trajet
fr.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: Plutôt adaptées — les infrastructures sont assez bonnes sur la majeure partie de mon trajet
fr.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Très adaptées — les infrastructures cyclables sont excellentes sur tout mon trajet
fr.#Which of the following physical barrier: Quels obstacles physiques rencontrez-vous sur votre trajet à vélo ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#Uneven or poorly maintained road surfac: Chaussée irrégulière ou mal entretenue (nids-de-poule, réparations, pavés)
fr.#Steep or sudden changes in gradient: Pentes fortes ou changements brusques de pente
fr.#Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle: Voitures ou autres véhicules garés qui bloquent les pistes cyclables
fr.#Pedestrians or e-scooters using cycle l: Piétons ou trottinettes électriques sur les pistes cyclables
fr.#Road furniture blocking cycle paths (bi: Mobilier urbain qui bloque les pistes cyclables (poubelles, panneaux, affiches publicitaires)
fr.#Lack of cycle-friendly crossings or tra: Manque de traversées ou de feux adaptés aux cyclistes
fr.#I don't face any physical barrier: Je ne rencontre aucun obstacle physique
fr.#If you encounter poor road or path surf: Quand la chaussée ou le chemin est en mauvais état, par exemple avec des nids-de-poule, des pavés ou un sol irrégulier, quel effet cela a-t-il sur vos déplacements à vélo ?
fr.#It does not affect my cycling at all: Cela n’a aucun effet sur mes déplacements à vélo
fr.#I notice it but continue without changi: Je le remarque, mais je continue sans changer ma façon de rouler
fr.#I slow down or adjust my line but stay: Je ralentis ou je change légèrement ma trajectoire, mais je reste sur le même itinéraire
fr.#I actively avoid roads with poor surfac: J’évite les routes en mauvais état, même si l’autre itinéraire est plus long
fr.#Poor surfaces significantly limit where: Le mauvais état des surfaces limite fortement les endroits où je peux aller à vélo et la fréquence de mes déplacements
fr.#To what extent does the steepness of yo: Dans quelle mesure la pente de votre itinéraire influence-t-elle vos déplacements à vélo ?
fr.#Slightly — I notice hills but they do n: Un peu — je remarque les montées, mais elles ne changent pas vraiment mon trajet
fr.#Moderately — hills slow me down or incr: Modérément — les montées me ralentissent ou augmentent nettement mon effort
fr.#Significantly — I avoid steep routes wh: Beaucoup — j’évite les itinéraires très pentus quand c’est possible
fr.#Extremely — hills are a major barrier t: Énormément — les montées sont un obstacle important qui limite mes déplacements à vélo
fr.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: Quel effet la qualité des panneaux et des indications d’orientation sur votre itinéraire à vélo a-t-elle sur votre trajet ?
fr.#Not at all — I can navigate easily rega: Aucun — je peux facilement m’orienter même si la signalisation est mauvaise
fr.#Slightly — signs are occasionally helpf: Faible — les panneaux sont parfois utiles
fr.#Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm: Modéré — j’utilise les panneaux pour vérifier mon itinéraire
fr.#Significantly — unclear or missing sign: Important — des panneaux peu clairs ou absents perturbent parfois mon trajet
fr.#Very significantly — poor signage makes: Très important — une mauvaise signalisation rend l’orientation difficile sans GPS ou application sur téléphone
fr.#How do traffic levels and vehicle speed: Comment le niveau de trafic et la vitesse des véhicules sur votre itinéraire à vélo influencent-ils généralement votre trajet ?
fr.#Not at all — traffic does not affect my: Pas du tout — le trafic n’a pas d’effet sur mon expérience à vélo
fr.#Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rar: Un peu — je remarque le trafic, mais il change rarement mon confort ou mon itinéraire
fr.#Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces: Modérément — le trafic réduit parfois mon confort ou le plaisir de faire du vélo
fr.#Significantly — traffic often makes me: Beaucoup — le trafic me fait souvent sentir stressé(e) ou en danger
fr.#Very significantly — I change my route: Énormément — je change mon itinéraire ou mon heure de déplacement pour éviter un trafic dense ou rapide
fr.#Which categories of road users most neg: Quelles catégories d’usagers de la route réduisent le plus votre sentiment de sécurité à vélo ?
fr.#Delivery vehicles (vans, cargo bikes, s: Véhicules de livraison (fourgonnettes, vélos cargo, scooters)
fr.#Taxi or ride-hailing drivers: Conducteurs de taxi ou de VTC
fr.#None — no category negatively affects m: Aucune — aucune catégorie ne réduit mon sentiment de sécurité
fr.#How confident are you in your ability t: À quel point vous sentez-vous capable d’anticiper et de réagir aux situations dangereuses à vélo, par exemple une portière qui s’ouvre soudainement, un véhicule qui coupe votre trajectoire ou un carrefour avec mauvaise visibilité ?
fr.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Pas du tout en confiance — je ne me sens pas préparé(e) à ces situations
fr.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Un peu en confiance — je connais les risques, mais je suis souvent surpris(e)
fr.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Modérément en confiance — je gère la plupart des situations, mais certaines m’inquiètent encore
fr.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Plutôt en confiance — j’anticipe la plupart des dangers et je réagis correctement
fr.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Très en confiance — je me sens bien préparé(e) aux dangers habituels à vélo
fr.#How does street lighting affect your de: Quel effet l’éclairage public a-t-il sur votre décision de faire du vélo après la tombée de la nuit ?
fr.#Lighting levels have no influence on my: Le niveau d’éclairage n’influence pas ma décision de faire du vélo après la tombée de la nuit
fr.#I notice poor lighting but it does not: Je remarque quand l’éclairage est mauvais, mais cela ne change ni l’heure ni l’endroit où je fais du vélo
fr.#I cycle at reduced speed or stay on hig: Je roule moins vite ou je reste sur des rues mieux éclairées dans les zones sombres
fr.#I take significantly longer routes to s: Je prends des itinéraires nettement plus longs pour rester dans des zones bien éclairées
fr.#I do not cycle after dark because of po: Je ne fais pas de vélo après la tombée de la nuit à cause du mauvais éclairage
fr.#How would you describe the availability: Comment décririez-vous la disponibilité du stationnement pour vélos à votre destination la plus fréquente ?
fr.#Very inadequate — there is nowhere secu: Très insuffisante — il n’y a aucun endroit sûr pour garer mon vélo
fr.#Inadequate — parking exists but is too: Insuffisante — il y a du stationnement, mais il est trop limité ou trop loin de ma destination
fr.#Partially adequate — parking is availab: Partiellement adaptée — il y a du stationnement, mais il n’est pas toujours pratique ou sûr
fr.#Mostly adequate — I can usually find a: Plutôt adaptée — je trouve généralement un endroit convenable pour garer mon vélo
fr.#Very adequate — secure and convenient p: Très adaptée — un stationnement sûr et pratique est toujours disponible
fr.#Has the lack of secure bicycle parking: Le manque de stationnement sûr pour les vélos vous a-t-il déjà poussé à changer vos plans de déplacement ou à laisser votre vélo chez vous ?
fr.#Always — lack of parking is a constant: Toujours — le manque de stationnement est un obstacle permanent à mes déplacements à vélo
fr.#What improvements would most encourage: Quels changements vous encourageraient le plus à faire du vélo plus souvent ou sur de plus longues distances ?
fr.#More dedicated and physically separated: Davantage de pistes cyclables réservées et physiquement séparées du trafic
fr.#Better road surface quality on cycling: Une meilleure qualité de chaussée sur les itinéraires cyclables
fr.#More secure bicycle parking at destinat: Davantage de stationnements sûrs pour vélos à destination
fr.#More secure bicycle storage near home: Davantage d’espaces sûrs pour ranger les vélos près du domicile
fr.#Reduced vehicle speeds in residential a: Une vitesse plus faible des véhicules dans les zones résidentielles
fr.#Better cycle-friendly junctions and cro: Des carrefours et traversées mieux adaptés aux cyclistes
fr.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: Davantage d’arbres et d’ombre le long des itinéraires cyclables
fr.#Better street lighting on cycling route: Un meilleur éclairage public sur les itinéraires cyclables
fr.#Access to cycle training or skills cour: Des cours pour apprendre ou améliorer la pratique du vélo
fr.#Financial incentives (e.g., employer cy: Des aides financières (par exemple une indemnité vélo de l’employeur ou une aide à l’achat d’un vélo)
fr.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: Rien — les conditions actuelles me conviennent

de.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Cy: SmartUrbanity - Ihre Erfahrung mit dem Fahrrad
de.#Welcome to Your Experience With Cycling: Willkommen beim Fragebogen zu Ihrer Erfahrung mit dem Fahrrad
de.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Dieser SmartUrbanity-Fragebogen befasst sich mit Ihrer Erfahrung beim Radfahren oder mit dem E-Bike. Ihre Antworten helfen uns zu verstehen, welche Bedingungen und Hindernisse Menschen beim Radfahren in der Stadt erleben und wie Radfahren sicherer, zugänglicher und alltagstauglicher werden kann. Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und anonym.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren
de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#<p>Questions about how and when you cyc: Fragen dazu, wie und wann Sie das Fahrrad im Alltag nutzen.
de.#Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a m: Nutzen Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche ein Fahrrad oder E-Bike als Verkehrsmittel?
de.#Which type of bicycle do you most often: Welche Art von Fahrrad nutzen Sie am häufigsten?
de.#Shared / hire bicycle (docked or dockle: Leih- oder Sharing-Fahrrad (mit oder ohne Station)
de.#How confident are you cycling in urban: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich beim Radfahren im Stadtverkehr?
de.#Not confident at all — I avoid cycling: Gar nicht sicher — ich vermeide das Radfahren im Verkehr
de.#Not very confident — I cycle only when: Eher unsicher — ich fahre nur im Verkehr, wenn ich keine andere Möglichkeit habe
de.#Somewhat confident — I manage most situ: Eher sicher — ich komme mit den meisten Situationen gut zurecht
de.#Very confident — I cycle in all conditi: Sehr sicher — ich fahre unter allen üblichen Bedingungen ohne große Probleme
de.#I have never cycled in urban traffic: Ich bin noch nie im Stadtverkehr Fahrrad gefahren
de.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: Wie gut ist die Fahrradinfrastruktur auf Ihrer üblichen Strecke, zum Beispiel Radwege, Fahrstreifen und Beschilderung?
de.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Sehr schlecht — es gibt kaum oder keine Fahrradinfrastruktur
de.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: Schlecht — es gibt zwar Infrastruktur, aber sie ist lückenhaft oder schlecht gestaltet
de.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Teilweise gut — die Infrastruktur deckt einen Teil meiner Strecke ab
de.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: Meist gut — auf dem größten Teil meiner Strecke ist die Infrastruktur in Ordnung
de.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Sehr gut — auf meiner gesamten Strecke ist die Fahrradinfrastruktur sehr gut
de.#Which of the following physical barrier: Welche baulichen oder körperlichen Hindernisse begegnen Ihnen auf Ihrer Radstrecke? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)

de.#Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle: Geparkte Autos oder andere Fahrzeuge, die Radwege blockieren
de.#Road furniture blocking cycle paths (bi: Gegenstände oder Stadtmöbel, die Radwege blockieren (Mülltonnen, Schilder, Werbetafeln)
de.#I don't face any physical barrier: Ich habe keine solchen körperlichen Hindernisse
de.#If you encounter poor road or path surf: Wenn Straßen oder Wege schlecht sind, zum Beispiel durch Schlaglöcher, Kopfsteinpflaster oder Unebenheiten: Wie wirkt sich das auf Ihr Radfahren aus?
de.#It does not affect my cycling at all: Das beeinflusst mein Radfahren gar nicht
de.#I notice it but continue without changi: Ich merke es, fahre aber weiter, ohne mein Verhalten zu ändern
de.#I slow down or adjust my line but stay: Ich fahre langsamer oder ändere meine Linie etwas, bleibe aber auf derselben Strecke
de.#I actively avoid roads with poor surfac: Ich vermeide Straßen mit schlechtem Belag, auch wenn der alternative Weg länger ist
de.#Poor surfaces significantly limit where: Schlechte Oberflächen schränken stark ein, wo und wie oft ich Rad fahren kann
de.#To what extent does the steepness of yo: Wie stark beeinflusst die Steigung Ihrer Strecke Ihr Radfahren?
de.#Slightly — I notice hills but they do n: Etwas — ich merke Steigungen, aber sie beeinflussen meine Fahrt kaum
de.#Moderately — hills slow me down or incr: Mäßig — Steigungen verlangsamen mich oder machen die Fahrt deutlich anstrengender
de.#Significantly — I avoid steep routes wh: Stark — ich vermeide steile Strecken, wenn es möglich ist
de.#Extremely — hills are a major barrier t: Sehr stark — Steigungen sind ein großes Hindernis und schränken ein, wo ich Rad fahren kann
de.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: Wie beeinflussen Qualität und Verständlichkeit von Schildern und Wegweisung auf Ihrer Radstrecke Ihre Fahrt?
de.#Not at all — I can navigate easily rega: Gar nicht — ich finde meinen Weg auch bei schlechter Beschilderung problemlos
de.#Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm: Mäßig — ich nutze Schilder, um meine Route zu bestätigen
de.#Significantly — unclear or missing sign: Stark — unklare oder fehlende Schilder stören manchmal meine Fahrt
de.#Very significantly — poor signage makes: Sehr stark — schlechte Beschilderung macht die Orientierung ohne GPS oder Handy-App schwierig
de.#How do traffic levels and vehicle speed: Wie beeinflussen Verkehrsmenge und Geschwindigkeit der Fahrzeuge auf Ihrer Radstrecke normalerweise Ihre Fahrt?
de.#Not at all — traffic does not affect my: Gar nicht — der Verkehr beeinflusst mein Radfahren nicht
de.#Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rar: Etwas — ich bemerke den Verkehr, aber er beeinflusst Komfort oder Route nur selten
de.#Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces: Mäßig — der Verkehr macht das Radfahren manchmal weniger angenehm
de.#Significantly — traffic often makes me: Stark — der Verkehr führt oft dazu, dass ich mich gestresst oder unsicher fühle
de.#Very significantly — I change my route: Sehr stark — ich ändere gezielt Route oder Fahrzeit, um starken oder schnellen Verkehr zu vermeiden
de.#Which categories of road users most neg: Welche Gruppen von Verkehrsteilnehmenden beeinträchtigen Ihr Sicherheitsgefühl beim Radfahren am stärksten?

de.#How confident are you in your ability t: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich darin, gefährliche Situationen beim Radfahren früh zu erkennen und darauf zu reagieren, zum Beispiel plötzlich geöffnete Autotüren, abbiegende Fahrzeuge oder unübersichtliche Kreuzungen?
de.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Gar nicht sicher — ich fühle mich auf solche Situationen nicht vorbereitet
de.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Etwas sicher — ich kenne die Risiken, werde aber oft überrascht

de.#How does street lighting affect your de: Wie beeinflusst die Straßenbeleuchtung Ihre Entscheidung, nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit Fahrrad zu fahren?

de.#Inadequate — parking exists but is too: Schlecht — es gibt Abstellplätze, aber zu wenige oder zu weit vom Ziel entfernt

de.#Has the lack of secure bicycle parking: Hat fehlendes sicheres Fahrradparken schon einmal dazu geführt, dass Sie Ihre Pläne geändert oder das Fahrrad zu Hause gelassen haben?

de.#What improvements would most encourage: Welche Verbesserungen würden Sie am meisten dazu ermutigen, häufiger oder längere Strecken Fahrrad zu fahren?
